stdout:
usage: fleet-switchboard agents [-h] {verify,charters} ...

positional arguments:
  {verify,charters}
    verify           Ask the running OpenCode service for its agents and
                     compare each of ours with its expected mode and the rules
                     its definition declares
    charters         Read-only: per live orchestrator, its registry charter
                     and its live session metadata's charter and issue (where
                     a charter number is recorded)

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit

usage: fleet-switchboard charter [-h] {set} ...

positional arguments:
  {set}
    set       Write the registry's charter of an orchestrator: an issue
              number, or none

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

usage: fleet-switchboard close-pane [-h] pane

positional arguments:
  pane        The herdr pane id

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

usage: fleet-switchboard comment [-h] --issue ISSUE --body-file BODY_FILE

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --issue ISSUE         The issue to comment on
  --body-file BODY_FILE
                        The comment: a file, or - for stdin

usage: fleet-switchboard bootstrap [-h] [--workspace LABEL] [--dir DIR]
                                   [--no-focus]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --workspace LABEL  The workspace's label (default: Chief of Staff)
  --dir DIR          The Chief of Staff's working directory (default: here)
  --no-focus         Open the workspace without taking focus (for scripts and
                     trials)

usage: fleet-switchboard agents verify [-h] [--strict]
                                       [--installed-dir INSTALLED_DIR]
                                       [--opencode OPENCODE]
                                       [--timeout TIMEOUT]

Reads `opencode api GET /api/agent` and fails (exit 1) when an agent of the
kit is missing, has the wrong mode or lacks a rule its definition declares. A
service that is not running is reported, not failed. Run it after installing
the agents and restarting the service.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --strict              Exit 1 when the service cannot be asked (default: say
                        so and exit 0)
  --installed-dir INSTALLED_DIR
                        The folder of installed agent files to compare bodies
                        with (default: the private profile's agents folder)
  --opencode OPENCODE   The opencode executable (default: opencode on PATH)
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Seconds to wait for the service (default 20)

usage: fleet-switchboard agents charters [-h] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --json

usage: fleet-switchboard charter set [-h] [--from SENDER] name charter

The registry row's `charter` is the one record of which charter an
orchestrator owns; the lane lookup reads it. The live session's metadata is
written once at launch and cannot be corrected, so it is never read as a
second owner. Run by the Chief of Staff or the operator; one audit line with
the old and the new value.

positional arguments:
  name           The orchestrator's fleet name
  charter        An issue number, or `none`

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --from SENDER  Lab only: the caller's fleet name
